# AUTO-GENERATED by tools/emit_research_events.mjs - do not edit by hand.
# The war and fleet research gates. Computed here because a scripted_progress_bar has no valid ROOT;
# the bars read the variables this sets. See ROADMAP.md -> "The war channel" / "The NAVAL channel".
#
# LANDMINE L22 - WHY THIS REGISTERS NAMED ON_ACTIONS INSTEAD OF WRITING `effect` DIRECTLY.
# An on_action's `events` list MERGES across files; its `effect` block does NOT. Vanilla declares
# on_monthly_pulse_country with its own 1005-line effect in common/on_actions/00_code_on_actions.txt,
# and a second `effect` does not compose - the engine keeps the most recently loaded and DISCARDS the
# other, logging one line in a file full of vanilla's own noise. As zzz_ we loaded last and won, so
# Ottoman and Portuguese monarchy succession and ruler-trait rolls silently stopped running across
# fifteen tagged countries. Registering `on_actions = { ... }` merges instead, which is the idiom
# zzz_v3tb_telemetry.txt and zzz_pm_rehaul_diag.txt already used.
on_monthly_pulse_country = {
	on_actions = {
		pmr_wargate_eval
	}
}

			set_variable = { name = pmr_navown_pre_dreadnought_tech  days = 40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_rival_country = {
					any_scope_ship = {
						OR = {
							is_ship_type = ship_type:ship_type_pre_dreadnought
							is_ship_type = ship_type:ship_type_armored_cruiser
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = pmr_navrival_pre_dreadnought_tech  days = 40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_ship = {
					OR = {
						is_ship_type = ship_type:ship_type_protected_cruiser
						is_ship_type = ship_type:ship_type_torpedo_boat_destroyer
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = pmr_navown_sea_lane_strategies  days = 40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_rival_country = {
					any_scope_ship = {
						OR = {
							is_ship_type = ship_type:ship_type_protected_cruiser
							is_ship_type = ship_type:ship_type_torpedo_boat_destroyer
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = pmr_navrival_sea_lane_strategies  days = 40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_ship = {
					is_ship_type = ship_type:ship_type_torpedo_boat
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = pmr_navown_self_propelled_torpedoes  days = 40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_rival_country = {
					any_scope_ship = {
						is_ship_type = ship_type:ship_type_torpedo_boat
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = pmr_navrival_self_propelled_torpedoes  days = 40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_scope_ship = {
					is_ship_type = ship_type:ship_type_submarine
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = pmr_navown_submarine  days = 40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_rival_country = {
					any_scope_ship = {
						is_ship_type = ship_type:ship_type_submarine
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = pmr_navrival_submarine  days = 40 }
		}
	}
}
